description: Writer H monad — invisible cost accumulation as a categorical structure (notes/24 §3). Checked that for the 4-level Heyting algebra, all permutations of a fixed list of costs yield the same total log. This is the standard join-semilattice law (∨ assoc/comm/idempotent, §3.3), not a novel theorem.

bridge_demo.lesson: Same Kleisli chain length (15 arrows), but the accumulated log differs by Heyting rank because each transition emits a different cost level. The monadic ∨-accumulation re-derives the §P4 backbone separation without simulating tokens.
